findings.title: Standard real-system simulator omits new unconditional MCU dependencies
findings.detail: Board now unconditionally instantiates alpha68kn_mcu. The build script copies neither alpha68kn_mcu.sv nor t48_core.v and omits alpha68kn_mcu.sv from the Verilator SV file list. Its source SHA receipt also excludes vendor/t48/t48_core.v. files.qip fixes only the Quartus graph. Update source copy, explicit MCU SV compile input and donor source hashing before merging; include T48 in the copied .v closure.

profile0_1_review: Diff manually reviewed; profile2-gated MCU, CPU pause, RAM arbitration, firmware IRQ/flip and HLE exclusion reduce to the existing board behavior. Sound map enumerated for every address in both profiles. This is structural/finite evidence, not sequential formal or game replay.
shared_ssg_scope: Intentional period-zero change affects all profiles and requires current-source replay binding.
merge_exclusions: sim/coupled_observer.vlt is private diagnostic configuration and need not enter production.
conditional_gates: Keep production profile admission <=1 until genuine181 gameplay and realHPS wrapper gates pass.
New board/MCU/T48/divider require complete current-source resource/all-corner timing acceptance.
metadata_notes: Prefer repository-relative license_notice.path during production metadata integration; retained neighboring LICENSE.upstream hash is correct.
